build_fasttext_corpus: create a fastText training corpus from CC shard files using DMOZ category tags
download_dmoz_tags: download the DMOZ tagging RDF file from the web archive to a local path
load_dmoz_tags: parse a DMOZ RDF file and return a dictionary mapping URLs and domains to topic tags
add_tags_to_url: add or intersect DMOZ topic tags for a given URL in the url2tags dictionary
review_make_corpus: review the make_corpus function that filters documents by DMOZ tags and writes fastText-labeled output
